package.title: User search accepts the full email (drop the legacy @-strip in both add-user modals)

specification.intent: Both add-user modals (messenger and the contacts page) strip every '@' out of the search input before the debounced prefix search, so typing a full email (alice@chatty.local) degenerates to the prefix alicechatty.local and finds nothing. The backend already matches prefixes containing '@' (pinned by test_social_api.py:129) — the fix removes the legacy @-strip in the two input handlers and updates the shared hint text; prefix semantics, debounce, refocus and disabled-result behaviour stay as they are.

requirements.title: Drop the @-strip in both add-user modals; the full email reaches the search verbatim
requirements.description: src/components/messenger/messenger.ts: delete the @-strip block in the root-delegated input handler (raw.includes('@') -> split/join -> input.value rewrite) so the typed value goes to the debounced onSearchUsers unchanged; update the renderAddUserModalContent hint to «Начните вводить начало или полный email — поиск сработает сам» (one place — the contacts page reuses the builder); update the stale @-marker comment. src/features/contacts/pages/contacts/contacts.ts: delete the mirrored @-strip block in the page input handler. Tests: messenger.test.ts and contacts.test.ts REPLACE the @-strip expectations with verbatim-pass pins (query 'alice@chatty.local' reaches onSearchUsers/searchUsers unchanged, input value not rewritten) while prefix-only queries still search. No backend change (test_social_api.py:129 stays the full-email pin).
requirements.source: operator request 2026-11-01 (admin could not find alice/caro1 typing the full email; live-diagnosed: strip mangles the query, backend returns the users for plain prefixes)

specification.goal: Typing the full email into either add-user modal finds the user; bare prefixes keep working.
constraints: Layers only downward; guard-architecture --all --strict stays green; no new imports or components.
Search semantics stay PREFIX (server LIKE prefix%, server order, cap 10) — only the destroyed characters change; no backend file is touched.
The existing messenger debounce test asserts the @-strip and MUST be updated to the verbatim-pass expectation (verify must not break).
Existing suites stay green; mocha count grows from the 422 contacts-feature baseline.
nonGoals: backend repository/endpoint changes (already correct and pinned)
email-format validation of the typed query
